item.title: Tingus Goose review - ChristCenteredGamer
item.description: CCG writes - "If you enjoy idle clickers and have a silly sense of humor, youll love Tingus Goose. Before the game launched there was a demo available, but sadly it is no longer available since the games launch. The asking price is reasonable and you can get a lot of enjoyment out of it. After completing the main game, you can continue to play in the epilogue mode and customize your game by selecting your level and suitor."

item.title: PS5 vs Xbox Series Sales Comparison - November 2025
item.description: November 2025 is the 61st month the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S has been available for. In the latest month, the gap grew in favor of the PlayStation 5 when compared to the aligned launch of the Xbox Series X|S by 3.37 million units. In the last 12 months, the PlayStation 5 has outsold the Xbox Series X|S by 15.00 million units. The PlayStation 5 is currently ahead by 52.02 million units.
